title: Report a problem
sent: Thanks — it’s with us. We’ll reply by email if we need to know more.

errors.forbidden: You can’t send a report from here.
errors.empty: Write a line about what happened.
errors.tooLong: That’s too long. Keep it under 4000 characters.
errors.badScreenshot: We couldn’t use that screenshot. Send without it, or pick another.
errors.tooLarge: That image is too large even when shrunk. Send without it, or pick a smaller one.
errors.rateLimited: You’ve just sent a few. Try again in an hour.
errors.unavailable: That didn’t arrive. Try again in a moment.
